sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Back: the right wing is on the right now. It spreads out from the right shoulder, past the head, as the left wing does on the left; it is a little smaller because it is the far one. Before, it came up on the left of the head, beside the left wing. Nothing else changed.

note: Twentieth look. Delta Charizard: the back's right wing is moved to the right side.
